crann_baker.text: Crann is the Irish word for a tree, and for a ship's mast. We liked the sound of it.
Our soda bread has no yeast. It rises on bread soda and buttermilk, because Irish wheat is soft and low in gluten.
Cut a cross in the top before it goes in the oven. The old story says it lets the fairies out.

then.text: One loaf per customer, I am afraid. The gulls have been watching.

else.text: Here, take a loaf for the road. Do not share it with the gulls, they will remember you.

crann_regular.text: If something is 'grand' in Galway it is fine, which can mean anything from wonderful to adequate.
Watch your chips on the quay. Chipgulls round here have a very organised supply chain.
